While reading the 460-residue filings, these cells were found to store a con value that does
NOT match the company's own filed consolidated 'Profit for the period' at all -- neither the
total nor the owners figure. The owners-vs-total gate (total_read == stored) correctly REFUSES
them: the stored number came from somewhere the filing does not corroborate (a wrong vintage, a
restatement whose provenance is unestablished, or a pipeline error). Each needs a SEPARATE audit
of where the stored value originated before it can be corrected -- healing straight to the filed
owners could revert a legitimate restatement. Fields: stored (what we serve), filed_total and
filed_owners (from the company's own filing this session), src (the filing read).
